title: Jesus... Why Am I Crying When Nothing's Wrong? 😭
topic: she cried in the car after a genuinely good day and cannot explain the tears to anyone, least of all herself

bible.text: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why am I crying when nothing's wrong? 😭

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Good day at work. Laughed with the team. Then the engine off, and it all came out.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tears aren't always a complaint. Sometimes they're everything you carried quietly, finally leaving.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I'm blessed, shouldn't I be joyful?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You can be blessed and still be tired. Both fit in the same car.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Nothing broke today. Something heavy just left.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When did tears come with no warning? 👇
